title: The Summer of Punk
summary: Punk challenges WWE’s power structure and threatens to leave with its championship. His victory over Cena creates competing claims to the title.

chapters.title: The pipe-bomb promo
chapters.result: CM Punk delivers his confrontation with WWE management.
chapters.context: The speech gives the impending title match stakes beyond a routine championship challenge.

chapters.title: Punk leaves Chicago with the championship
chapters.result: CM Punk defeats John Cena and exits with the WWE title.
chapters.context: Punk makes good on the central promise of the storyline.

chapters.title: Two champions, then another cash-in
chapters.result: Punk defeats Cena; Alberto Del Rio then cashes in and wins the title.
chapters.context: Kevin Nash’s attack creates the opening for Del Rio.
